what: The launch tower as the introduction builds it (towers.T04-launch-graduate), without its display: graduation, both lamps lit and the token's disc on its arc into the pool.

code.note: packages/world as on main (base), plus the rig named here (src/stations/_objects): the stations' own builders and frames from the frame data, with the rig's camera, or the chapter's own with its lens narrowed onto the object where the frame is a crop

render.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh <port>, then node scripts/render.mjs --port <port> --frames _objects.tower-launch --out <dir> --w 1280 --h 720 --scale 2 --plates 0 --raw --repeat 2
render.gpu: ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Max

png_1280.size: 1280 x 720, render.mjs's Lanczos from the master

png_640.size: 640 x 360, ffmpeg's Lanczos from the master

rerender_when: the launch tower (stations/towers/launch.ts), the rig, or the frame data changes
